title: SaneTools
description: The Sane Scraper: a balanced quality-of-life tool for faster block gathering in vanilla+ Minecraft, or to complement other tool mods.
body:
Sane Tools – Sane Scraper (v1.0)

The Sane Scraper is a quality-of-life tool designed to remove the tedium of gathering blocks one by one. Spending so much time digging just doesn’t seem reasonable — this tool allows you to harvest multiple blocks of the same type in the same plane efficiently without breaking vanilla survival balance.

![Sane scraper iron recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1695ee7c497a25ff198200b3cb50e1e05317cf8.png)

**Features:**

	Balanced tiers: wood, iron, and diamond (infinite)
	Works in survival and creative modes
	Uses durability and hunger to limit usage, without disappearing

Note: Recipes are not yet visible in JEI or the vanilla recipe book; they will be added in a future update.

**Videos:**

	Scraper in action: <iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/v-jDsesuoRI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**State of Development:**

	Fully functional as intended
	No planned changes except potentially add the other 2 tools in the SaneTools set

**Durability:**

	Tools do not break permanently; they can always be repaired
	Diamond tier is effectively infinite
